name: OVERHEAD PIPING SYSTEM
text: Thick metal pipes run along the ceiling,
dropping down with small valves and fixtures.
The grey finish is scuffed in places,
suggesting years of maintenance in this humid

name: LOWER WALL PIPING
text: A network of smaller pipes hugs the lower edge
of the wall, leading towards the main console
area. They look like they handle coolant or
fluid return from the agricultural units.

name: WESTERN COMPUTER TERMINAL
text: A bulky, grey console unit sits against the
wall, its green screen glowing faintly with
streams of data. It appears to monitor the
adjacent row of plant cultivation tanks.

name: LOWER CONTROL CONSOLE
text: A secondary console is built into the wall
here, featuring a slanted keyboard and a
smaller vertical screen. It looks well-used,
perhaps an older model integrated into the

name: FLOOR PUDDLE
text: A large, dark puddle has collected in the
center of the room, reflecting the cyan glow
of the tanks. It hints at a slow leak or
condensation dripping from the overhead

name: UPPER WALKWAY SECTION
text: A section of metal grating forms a small
walkway above, separated by a bright cyan
glow. It seems designed for overhead access or
ventilation flow.

name: EASTERN COMPUTER TERMINAL
text: This workstation features a large green
display and a keypad, set against a panel of
orange-lit grating. It likely controls the
environmental parameters for this side of the

name: LEFTMOST CULTIVATION TANKS
text: A stack of transparent cylindrical tanks
houses leafy green plants, bathed in a cool
cyan light. The glass is slightly fogged,
showing the high humidity inside each chamber.

name: SECOND ROW CULTIVATION TANKS
text: This vertical arrangement of tanks holds a
variety of smaller, bushier plants. The bottom
tank seems to contain some sort of fungal or
root-based growth, distinct from the others.

name: UPPER LEFT WALL SECTION
text: The wall here is painted a utilitarian grey,
broken by a rusty pipe and a small ventilation
fan. A single orange light bulb casts a warm
glow over a section of metal grating.

name: RIGHTMOST CULTIVATION TANKS
text: The final row of tanks displays taller, stalky
plants, illuminated by the same pervasive cyan
glow. The base of the unit shows intricate
piping connecting it to the room's central

name: FOURTH ROW CULTIVATION TANKS
text: These tanks contain plants with broad, spiky
leaves, growing robustly in their artificial
environment. The structure shows slight signs
of wear around the metal casing joints.

name: LOWER RIGHT PIPING
text: A cluster of pipes runs along the floor and
lower wall, leading towards an out-of-sight
utility area. A small ventilation unit sits
nearby, its grill caked with a bit of dust.

name: THIRD ROW CULTIVATION TANKS
text: This stack of tanks shows a mix of leafy and
stem-heavy plants. The bottommost chamber
seems empty or houses something very small,
waiting for its next cycle.
